title: 第845章 沈平伊的围杀第844章 小队重整
lines: 李骏小队分成三股，扩散清除魔兵以及魔尸。
一头高阶魔兽正趴在山谷里啃食尸体。
浑身长满黑色鳞甲，背部长着骨刺。
它察觉李骏等人后，瞬间暴起！
众人同时出手，骑着奔獠兽，施展威灵阵冲锋而去。
一击让魔兽受伤，随后众人立刻施展术法！
墨梓欣挥手洒出大片冰针。
四条雷龙破空，直接贯穿魔兽的躯体。
远处传来魔兽的兽蹄声。
只见一队“雇佣兵”缓缓靠近。
为首之人灵光遮面，但气息却让李骏感到隐隐熟悉。
沈平伊早前就从章兴口中得知，李骏从正安城大战活了下来，而且放冷箭灭杀魔兵，军功官至百夫长，他心中愤恨不服。
而今，他支援重建灵硫城归来，恰巧遇到李骏，心里想着干脆就在此地，灭杀李骏，如今兵荒马乱，就算死了也可以赖在魔兽和残留的魔兵身上。
于是，沈平伊叫上队内的十名心腹，让其余人先行回去。这十个人换上了雇佣兵的服饰，全部灵光遮面。其中就有四名元婴修士，灭杀李骏，他们心中大定。
沈平伊看着李骏，特别是看到刚才李骏施展雷龙印，眼中贪念更重。
content_en:
Near the military road, there was a gloomy wind.
Li Jun's team was divided into three groups and spread out to eliminate the demon soldiers and demon corpses.
A high-level monster was lying in the valley eating corpses.
The whole body is covered with black scales and there are bone spurs on the back.
"Roar——!!!"
After it noticed Li Jun and others, it burst into flames instantly!
The giant claw is shot down!
boom!
The ground exploded!
Han Xu shouted angrily:
"Formation!"
Everyone took action at the same time, riding the running beast, using the powerful spirit formation to charge away.
boom!
One blow injured the monster, and then everyone immediately cast spells!
Mo Zixin waved her hand and scattered large ice needles.
"Cold Soul Thorn!"
Puff puff puff!
The ice needle pierced the monster's eye.
The monster is furious.
Li Jun activated the Thunder Dragon Seal.
"Whoosh!"
Four thunder dragons broke through the air and penetrated directly into the body of the monster.
"Roar!!!"
The monster rolled wildly.
Fengze rushed forward and chopped it down with a single blow.
"Pfft——"
Half of the head flew up.
Demonic blood sprayed.
Everyone just breathed a sigh of relief.
suddenly——
The sound of hooves of monsters could be heard in the distance.
Li Jun frowned and turned back.
I saw a group of "mercenaries" approaching slowly.
The leader's face was covered by aura, but his aura made Li Jun feel vaguely familiar.
This person is Shen Pingyi.
Shen Pingyi had learned earlier from Zhang Xing that Li Jun had survived the battle in Zheng'an City and had fired cold arrows to kill the demonic soldiers. He was a centurion in military merit. He was resentful and dissatisfied.
Now, he was returning to support the reconstruction of Ling Sulfur City, and he happened to meet Li Jun. He thought that he would kill Li Jun right here. Now that the war was in chaos, even if he died, he could rely on the monsters and the remaining magic soldiers.
So, Shen Pingyi called ten of his confidants in the team and asked the rest to go back first. These ten people put on the clothes of mercenaries, and their faces were all covered by spiritual light. Among them were four Nascent Soul cultivators who were determined to kill Li Jun.
Shen Pingyi looked at Li Jun, especially when he saw Li Jun performing the Thunder Dragon Seal just now, his eyes became even more greedy.
title_en: Chapter 845 Shen Pingyi’s siege Chapter 844 Team reorganization
